title: Notes file for the orchestrator example

tasks.title: Create the notes file
tasks.prompt: Create a file named NOTES.md in the current folder. Its first line must be exactly "# Notes" and its second line one sentence saying that RouDex routes each task to the right model. Do not create, change or delete any other file, and do not run commands.
acceptance: NOTES.md exists and starts with the line "# Notes".
No other file is created or changed.

tasks.title: List the router tiers
tasks.prompt: Append to NOTES.md a section titled "## Tiers" with the three RouDex tiers as a list, one per line: economico, estandar and fuerte. Keep the existing lines as they are. Do not create, change or delete any other file, and do not run commands.
acceptance: NOTES.md keeps its first two lines.
NOTES.md lists economico, estandar and fuerte under "## Tiers".
